user_prompt: In adult smokers, what is the effect of an Internet-based smoking cessation intervention combined with behavioural support, compared with a non-Internet-based non-active control, on smoking cessation at 6 months or longer follow-up? Evaluate ONLY smoking cessation/abstinence at ≥6 months. Use the study’s most rigorous reported definition of abstinence used for this comparison, and use one endpoint per study. Do not extract, classify, or pool short-term cessation outcomes (<6 months), quit attempts, smoking reduction, nicotine dependence, intervention usage, self-efficacy, or other outcomes. Pool the outcome as a dichotomous effect using Risk Ratio (RR).
